records.title: Raw bundle provenance preserves source observation truth separately from capture and persistence clocks
records.surface: Raw capture and source temporal law
adjudication_notes: The pre-repair Tier A extension failed because capture and persistence clocks alone were accepted as sufficient provenance.

The bounded repair mirrors the existing SourceTemporalStandard guard: source_time_utc or source_date is required; captured_at_utc and persisted_at_utc remain process clocks, not source observation truth.
The existing options wrapper specimen was updated to carry source_time_utc because wrappers using RawBundleLoader are now required to carry source observation truth.
non_claims: Does not prove all provider-specific temporal normalisation.
Does not upgrade the whole 5.2 surface to implemented.
Does not authorise live API, broker, decision, capital, or runtime trading behaviour.
